title: BT29001: Biochemistry Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Estimation of amino acid, protein, total protein, phospho-protein, from
different biological samples; electrophoresis; effect of pH temperature;
substrate concentration; concentration of enzyme; Km; Vmax and Ki determination
of half-life period of the enzyme and effect of protein denaturant.
